properties.accuracyNote: Approximate alignment (shared Caltrain corridor): the federal rail network's centreline for Caltrain's existing tracks, 46.8 miles from Fourth and King to San José Diridon. High-speed trains would share these tracks (Final EIR/EIS Alternative A, about 49 miles to West Alma Avenue); the line is not the Authority's engineered alignment and shows one centreline for a two-to-four-track corridor. It is split at Scott Boulevard, the ROD's south limit for this section (ROD point, 'approximate'). Stations are Caltrain's GTFS station points.
